decisionReason: June 18 ORCH local browser QA is green after product fixes. Hosted/current read-only safety shape passes, but unauthenticated hosted probes still do not prove the 181-record beta catalog. Hosted durable audit/ticket storage remains unproven, so hosted downloads must stay fail-closed unless owner-approved durable proof exists. Hali/Enoch final owner signoff and invite/send approval remain missing.

targets: portal-download-ticket-smoke fails in production-mode local server with audit-required 503; earlier dev-mode proof passed

blockers.requiredProof: Complete locally. June 18 ORCH browser QA report records 20 pages, 6 viewport widths, 33 screenshots, 0 failures, 0 console errors, and 0 network failures after product fixes.
blockers.safeNextStep: Keep hosted download workflows fail-closed unless durable hosted audit/download-ticket storage is proven and owner-approved. Do not weaken audit-required behavior.

blockers.requiredProof: Complete. Read-only hosted protection is proven at docs/runs/evidence/2026-06-17/hosted-readonly-probes/summary.json, and /api/beta-auth/session exposes readinessContract small-team-beta-readiness-2026-06-17.
blockers.safeNextStep: Keep this as the first hosted proof gate before any future invite.

blockers.requiredProof: Complete. Viewer, Contributor, Reviewer/Joanna, and Admin logged in through real hosted beta-session auth. Contributor and above used the church/location invite code path.
blockers.safeNextStep: Rotate or hand off credentials privately before Joanna testing. Never commit real codes, hashes, passwords, screenshots, logs, or fixture values.

blockers.requiredProof: Current code adds bundled-beta-catalog as a sanitized hosted fallback with 181 MVP 2024 LM Photos records and no source paths/checksums. Last stable hosted Reviewer count proof still returned demo fallback: rawTotal 16, approvedRaw 12, needsReview 2, archive 1, portalReady 1. Stable hosted redeploy and count probe remain required.
blockers.safeNextStep: Redeploy after review, then run read-only hosted count proof. Do not mutate ResourceSpace, Google Drive, source media, or hosted env without owner approval.

blockers.requiredProof: Partial. Hosted feedback POST/Admin visibility passed. Hosted Viewer blocked download failed closed with 503 audit-required and no source/original/private/checksum leak. Hosted upload/review persistence against real beta content remains unproven.
blockers.safeNextStep: Prove upload intake and review decisions against the real hosted beta content source, or explicitly document them as queued/fail-closed for Joanna. Do not fake persistence with local JSON or demo-only behavior.

blockers.requiredProof: Renew named tester list, roles, send owner, stop-test owner, feedback triage owner, and final GO/NO-GO decision after hosted/current gates close.
blockers.safeNextStep: Owner updates signoff record after proof. Codex does not send invites.

blockers.requiredProof: Decide whether historical June 15 evidence guards should be refreshed for the June 17 branch or kept as historical-lane checks.
